requirement.evidence: adopted the Annual General Adjustment (AGA) Order for Year 2026 which will allow eligible landlords to increase the 2025 permanent rent ceilings by 1.0% no earlier than January 1, 2026.
requirement.note: Regulation 1148 conditions, notice, and contact number are all stated in the notice. "No more than 1.0%" is a slight paraphrase of the stated increase.

key_value.evidence: The 2026 AGA of 1.0% represents 65% of the increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) for All Urban Consumers in the Bay Area during the period from July 1, 2024 - June 30, 2025, which was 1.5% as posted by the Bureau of Labor Statistics.

effective_date.evidence: which will allow eligible landlords to increase the 2025 permanent rent ceilings by 1.0% no earlier than January 1, 2026.
effective_date.note: January 1, 2026 is the earliest date the increase may be taken, not formally the effective date of the order, though this is a small step.

status.evidence: adopted the Annual General Adjustment (AGA) Order for Year 2026 which will allow eligible landlords to increase the 2025 permanent rent ceilings by 1.0% no earlier than January 1, 2026.
status.note: The notice presents the order as adopted and current. As of 2026-10-01, nothing in the document indicates it was repealed.

coverage.note: The card's coverage field is null.

citation.evidence: See Berkeley Municipal Code section 13.76.110A. for rules related to establishing the AGA.
citation.note: The notice cites BMC 13.76.110A for establishing the AGA and identifies the Order as Rent Board Regulation 1148. The card ties both to one citation, which is acceptable, but 110A is about establishing the AGA, not the order's conditions.
